basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon, with a passion for quirky online communities. I love skateboarding and have a pet cat named Marbles. When I'm not working or skating, you can find me diving into digital art projects or engaging in lively discussions on Reddit. I usually browse Reddit late at night after work. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore various hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from the University of Oregon. My expertise extends to digital illustrations and meme creations, a skill I've honed over years of professional work and countless self-taught hours. I often share insights and tips on design forums, contributing to discussions on techniques and industry trends.
